items.text: The root cause is confirmed: thumbnails cap preload at half the slide count even in finite mode. That cap is valid only for wrapping mode; finite mode needs up to `slides.length - 1` neighbors. I’m centralizing the mode-aware cap and using it in both carousel and thumbnails.

I’m editing the shared preload helper, replacing the thumbnail-local cap, and adding a table-driven test across slide counts and preload values. The test checks real image thumbnails, so finite placeholders do not mask an incorrect count.
